sources.title: Introducing Lumma-Fev-27B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Lumma-Fev-27B was trained on about 100K samples, in a single pass over the data, covering English, Hindi, Tamil and Kannada. How we trained it Base: Qwen3.8-27B, all weights trained, fresh optimizer. A small readout head over the answer options replaces the language-model head. Recipe: a short, single-pass fine-tune, inspired by AutoJev.

sources.title: FrontiersMind/Lumma-fev-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Lumma-Fev-27B is a decision model. You give it a state (text) and typed questions; it returns a probability for every option in one forward pass. It never generates text, so there is nothing to parse. It works in English, Hindi, Tamil and Kannada, and was trained on about 100K samples. It is a full-weight fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B.

sources.title: FrontiersMind open-sources Lumma-fev-27B… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: FrontiersMind has open-sourced Lumma-fev-27B, its largest "decision model": instead of generating a label to parse, it scores the options you provide in a single forward pass. Built on Qwen3.8-27B with full fine-tuning (no LoRA, no frozen layers) on 100K decision samples, it supports English plus three Indic languages: Hindi, Tamil, and Kannada.
